compiled_state.title: Add serialize_manifest free function producing canonical JSON and sha256 hash
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-3: Canonical-manifest serializer produces stable ordering (sorted by (direction, action, target)) and content-addressable hash; unit test asserts hash stability across 100 randomized permutations

Add free function serialize_manifest(mutations) -> tuple[str, str] in mutation.py. Sorts input by (m.direction.value, m.action.value, m.target). Converts each Mutation to plain dict (direction/action as .value strings; payload/provenance as-is). json.dumps(sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'), ensure_ascii=True). Returns (json_text, hashlib.sha256(json_text.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()). Pure — no I/O, no time, no globals.

## Test Approach (Given/When/Then)
Given a fixed list of N Mutations and 100 randomized permutations of that list; When serialize_manifest is invoked on each permutation; Then all 100 invocations return identical (json_text, sha256_hash) pairs.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/mutation.py tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_mutation.py
- [ ] serialize_manifest returns byte-identical output for 100 random permutations
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_mutation.py::test_serialize_manifest_stable_across_100_permutations
- [ ] serialize_manifest sort key is (direction.value, action.value, target)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_mutation.py::test_serialize_manifest_sort_key
- [ ] serialize_manifest hash is sha256 of UTF-8 encoded json_text
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_mutation.py::test_serialize_manifest_hash_is_sha256_of_text

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/mutation.py — Edit
- tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_mutation.py — Edit

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user

comments.body: REVISION_CYCLE_1 (Step 4 plan review feedback): Add boundary tests: serialize_manifest([]) returns ('[]', sha256(b'[]')); single-element list stable across 100 invocations. Sort key explicitly uses Mutation.target field (str) — comment clarifies target carries jira_key|local_id depending on direction. Standardize N=100 (matches Task 4 purity test).
comments.author: Test

comments.body: AC amendment (gap analysis): Canonical serializer must constrain payload and provenance shape. (a) Declare Mutation.payload and Mutation.provenance as dict[str, JSON-scalar] only — no sets, datetimes, custom objects. (b) Add __post_init__ check in Mutation (task-1) rejecting non-conformant values. (c) Add test test_serialize_manifest_rejects_non_canonical_payload covering set/datetime/custom-object rejection. (d) If datetime values are needed, mandate ISO-8601 string serialization at Mutation construction, not at serialize_manifest time. Rationale: dd-1 and dd-3 depend on canonical serialization of every field — unspecified payload shape is the most likely source of flaky hash tests (implicit_assumption).
comments.author: Test
